props.command: Make an unshaded Godot material with a color uniform. Change the color, then rotate the mesh. Explain which change alters the flat color and why. Check two things: Rotation changes the silhouette, not the chosen color. The material exposes its color in the Inspector.
output: Rotation changes the silhouette, not the chosen color.
The material exposes its color in the Inspector.
